result.instructions: Tools for reenio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which reservations do we have tomorrow, and which of them are not paid yet?"; "Find the reservation for code ABC123 and check it in."; "Show the payment documents from last week so I can send them to the accountant.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes reenio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run reenio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run reenio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run reenio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. reenio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: reenio_check_access
tools.title: Check API key access
tools.description: Check that the reenio API key works. Returns accessible: true when reenio accepts it. GET /auth/checkaccess.

tools.name: reenio_get_user_info
tools.title: Get account and key owner
tools.description: Return the business account and the user the API key was issued for. GET /user/info.

tools.name: reenio_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations
tools.description: List reservations in a period, optionally filtered by place, service, employee or resource. Max 90 days per request. For the next page, pass only nextPage (from the previous response). Dates: yyyy-mm-dd or ISO 8601 UTC. GET /reservation.

start.description: Period start (inclusive). Required unless nextPage is given.

end.description: Period end (inclusive). Max 90 days after start. Required unless nextPage is given.

limit.description: Page size (the vendor default applies when omitted).

nextPage.description: The nextPage URL from the previous response, exactly as returned. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: reenio_get_reservation
tools.title: Get a reservation
tools.description: Get one reservation with its customer, tickets, price, paid flag, state and newStateOptions (the states it may move to). GET /reservation/{id}.

tools.name: reenio_find_reservation_by_code
tools.title: Find a reservation by code
tools.description: Find a reservation by its reservation code, for example from a QR code at check-in. GET /reservation/detailbycode/{code}.

tools.name: reenio_get_reservations
tools.title: Get several reservations
tools.description: Get the details of up to 100 reservations in one call. GET /reservations/{ids}.

tools.name: reenio_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers, one page at a time. For the next page, pass only nextPage. GET /customer.

limit.description: Page size (the vendor default applies when omitted).

nextPage.description: The nextPage URL from the previous response, exactly as returned. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: reenio_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer profile: contact details, address, custom fields, labels and note. GET /customer/{id}.

tools.name: reenio_get_customer_credit
tools.title: Get customer credit
tools.description: Get a customer's credit balance and its expiration. GET /customer/{id}/credit.

tools.name: reenio_list_payment_documents
tools.title: List payment documents
tools.description: List invoices and receipts whose payment was completed in a period. Max 90 days per request. For the next page, pass only nextPage. GET /paymentdocument.

start.description: Period start, yyyy-mm-dd (inclusive). Required unless nextPage is given.

end.description: Period end, yyyy-mm-dd (inclusive). Max 90 days after start. Required unless nextPage is given.

limit.description: Page size (the vendor default applies when omitted).

nextPage.description: The nextPage URL from the previous response, exactly as returned. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: reenio_get_reservation_payment_documents
tools.title: Get payment documents for a reservation
tools.description: List the payment documents (invoices, receipts) linked to one reservation. GET /paymentdocument/reservation/{id}.

annotations.title: Get payment documents for a reservation

tools.name: reenio_list_resources
tools.title: List places, services and employees
tools.description: List the reference data that reservations use: places, services, employees, resource combinations (place + service + employee) or capacity variants (for example adult and child). Changes rarely. GET /resource/place, /resource/service, /resource/employee, /resource, /capacityvariant.

kind.description: Which reference list to return. resource = combinations that resourceId refers to.

tools.name: reenio_list_blocking_times
tools.title: List blocked times
tools.description: List the time blocks in a period when reservations are not possible (recurring blocks are expanded into occurrences). GET /blockingtimeoccurence.

tools.name: reenio_list_reviews
tools.title: List customer reviews
tools.description: List customer reviews, one page at a time. For the next page, pass only nextPage. GET /review.

limit.description: Page size (the vendor default applies when omitted).

nextPage.description: The nextPage URL from the previous response, exactly as returned. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: reenio_search_coupon_code
tools.title: Search a coupon code
tools.description: Find a discount code by its text. Returns the code id, which reenio_redeem_coupon_code needs. GET /couponcode/search/{code}.

code.description: The discount code as the customer typed it.

tools.name: reenio_set_reservation_state
tools.title: Change reservation state
tools.description: Move a reservation to another state. Allowed states come from reenio_get_reservation (newStateOptions). Standard codes: 0 new, 1 confirmed, 2 cancelled, 3 did not take place, 4 took place, 5 no-show, 6 approved. PUT /reservation/{id}/state.

tools.name: reenio_set_reservation_paid
tools.title: Mark reservation paid or unpaid
tools.description: Set the paid flag of one reservation. PUT /reservation/{id}/ispaid.

tools.name: reenio_cancel_reservation
tools.title: Cancel a reservation
tools.description: Cancel one reservation. A paid reservation cannot be cancelled (HTTP 405). PUT /reservation/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: reenio_create_blocking_time
tools.title: Block a time
tools.description: Block a time so reservations are not possible, for example to mirror an external calendar. Give the period and at least one of placeId, serviceId, employeeId or resourceId. POST /blockingtimedefinition.

tools.name: reenio_delete_blocking_time
tools.title: Delete a blocked time
tools.description: Delete one blocked-time definition, so reservations are possible again. DELETE /blockingtimedefinition/{id}.

tools.name: reenio_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer details
tools.description: Update the first name, last name, degree or note of one customer. Pass only the fields to change. PATCH /customer/{id}.

tools.name: reenio_redeem_coupon_code
tools.title: Redeem a coupon code
tools.description: Mark a discount code as used (check in the code). Use the code id from reenio_search_coupon_code. PUT /couponcode/{id}/checkin.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with reenio
prompts.description: What you can do with reenio here, with example requests to try.
